title: Global context for AI agents: minimal to load, fast to find

slides.heading: The model knows the world, not your business.
slides.body: 5 steps to give an agent what the model cannot know.

slides.eyebrow: The gap, in a fictional example
slides.heading: Two sessions, no shared memory
slides.code:
# session 1, Tuesday
user:  Team plan goes up to $119
       next month.
agent: Got it.
saved: nothing

# session 2, Friday
context: no price, no map
search:  stripe, attio, db,
         drive, slack
found:   "Team plan: $99" (Slack)
output:  renewal email, $99

slides.heading: Split the information into domains
slides.code:
global-context/
  map.md
  sales/
    prices.md
    customers.md
  people/
    team.md
  product/
    roadmap.md

slides.heading: Write a map: one line for each domain
slides.code:
# map.md
sales/   Prices, discounts,
         plan changes, customers.
         Price list: prices.md
people/  Team, roles, who decides.
product/ Roadmap, release dates.

slides.heading: At session start, load only the map
slides.code:
# session start
load: map.md
rule: read the map before
      any tool call
slides.body: The domains stay saved, not loaded.

slides.heading: For each question, load one domain
slides.code:
ask:   How much is the Team plan?
route: sales/
load:  sales/prices.md
skip:  people/, product/
slides.body: Other domains are text that the model can confuse with the answer.

slides.heading: Save each change where it belongs
slides.code:
user: Team plan goes up to $119
      next month.
save: sales/prices.md
      Team: $99 -> $119

slides.heading: Same model. Next session: $119.
slides.code:
# session 2, Friday
load:   map.md
route:  sales/
load:   sales/prices.md
output: renewal email, $119

slides.heading: The two halves depend on each other.
list: The map only helps if what it points to is current.
A save only helps if the next session can find it.
Each domain must make sense alone. "Ask Sales" is useless to an agent.

slides.heading: Minimal to load, fast to find.
slides.body: Why the adapter (MCP, files, or a database) matters least, and a test for your own agent.
